channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Limerick suffer O'Donovan blow
item.description: Limerick are set to be without Darragh O'Donovan for the remainder of the Allianz Hurling League after he suffered a shoulder injury in yesterday's win over Offaly.

item.title: LGFA announced club championship Team of the Year
item.description: The LGFA have announced the AIB Ladies Gaelic Football Club Championship Team of the Year.

item.title: 'Hurling needs to be given oxygen'
item.description: Donal Óg Cusack has lamented the lack of support at last weekend's GAA Congress for the proposal to move the All-Ireland finals back into August.

item.title: Bannigan hoping Monaghan's injuries will clear
item.description: Garbiel Bannigan remains hopeful that Monaghan's 'staggering' injury situation will improve between now and the start of the Ulster SFC.

item.title: Donegal not rushing Patton back
item.description: Gavin Mulreany looks set to remain between the Donegal posts for the remainder of their Allianz Football League campaign as Shaun Patton continues his recovery from injury.

item.title: Referees stranded in Dubai amid Middle East crisis
item.description: Three well-known hurling referees are currently stranded in Dubai after flights were cancelled due to air strikes in the Middle East.

item.title: Down's Mooney comes out of retirement
item.description: Caolan Mooney has made a surprise return to the Down football fold.

item.title: Middle East conflict affects Canavan travel plans
item.description: Tyrone could yet have Darragh Canavan available for the last two rounds of the Allianz Football League after his planned flight to Australia last weekend was grounded by the conflict in the Middle East.

item.title: Over 150 clubs awarded in Ulster GAA Club Infrastructure Development Grant
item.description: One hundred and fifty-two clubs from across the province have been awarded a total of €857,923 of funding through Ulster GAA's 2025 Club Infrastructure Development Grant scheme.

item.title: Ballygunner to the fore as Hurling Club Championship Team of the Year named
item.description: The GAA have announced the AIB GAA Hurling Club Championship Team of the Year.
